page.marginRule: Equal on all four edges. One knob: --resume-page-margin. Never shrink it to fix overflow — move a section to the next page instead.

contentBox.rule: Each page's content must FIT this box. Overflow makes the pinned signature collide with the last lines.

pageModel.footer: .footer, .signature, .page-sig { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-end; text-align: right; }
pageModel.printPage: .page { height: 9.7in; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
pageModel.rule: Header flows at the top; signature pins bottom-RIGHT. Print CSS must repeat flex + set overflow: hidden (fixed page count).

signature.pin: margin-top: auto + align-self: flex-end (or text-align: right)
signature.not: Cover-letter bottom-LEFT — that is one-page-letter.json (CZI reference)

pagination.trap: A trailing break-after: page emits a phantom blank sheet.

bestFor: Every résumé and work-samples doc. Cover letters use one-page-letter.json — never this print height pattern on a letter.
